schemes.name: CMUdict selected US vocabulary / project ARPAbet adapter v1
schemes.limitations: Selected vocabulary only. All pronunciation variants retained; word lookup cannot resolve heteronyms. Stress precedes the ARPAbet vowel, not an inferred syllable onset. Broad phonemic approximation, not measured speech.

schemes.name: Exact IPA → CMUdict selected spelling candidates
schemes.limitations: Finite exact dictionary candidates; stress is significant. Not an inverse G2P and not all spellings.

schemes.name: CLDR 49 kana → Latin subset v1 (modified Hepburn family)
schemes.limitations: Common kana/digraphs, sokuon, syllabic n and prolonged-vowel mark. Explicit dji/dzu and n apostrophe policy. No Kanji, particles-as-pronunciation, halfwidth or iteration marks; not complete Hepburn or full ICU conformance.

schemes.name: CLDR 49 Cyrillic → Latin, Russian alphabet subset v1
schemes.limitations: Modern Russian alphabet, case and ASCII spaces only; not ISO 9 conformance. Inverse applies only to this exact alphabet/output repertoire, compared in NFC.

schemes.name: Inverse of CLDR 49 Russian alphabet subset v1
schemes.limitations: Exact bounded alphabet inverse; not IPA-to-Russian spelling.

schemes.name: CLDR 49 Han → tone-marked Latin default readings
schemes.limitations: Han character readings, not full word segmentation or Mandarin G2P. 三 phrase contexts 藏文/重庆/秘鲁; isolated contextual characters return alternatives. Other polyphony is not resolved. Pinyin is not IPA.

schemes.name: eSpeak NG 1.52.0 en-us G2P
schemes.limitations: Optional pinned local executable and voice data. Broad rule-based transcription; unknown words and isolated heteronyms may be wrong. No claim of whole-language accuracy or non-English synthesis. Custom executable overrides have unverified version.
